convention/cafe_cd.note: AUC 0.812 as-is vs 0.281 transposed: CAFE-CD uses A[effect, cause], the repo convention.  The strict min-max margin is -0.1252 because CAFE-CD scores BOTH directions of an unoriented edge highly by design; the mean margin is +0.2694.

convention/cafe_scale_sensitivity.note: scale_sensitive=True means CAFE-CD's RANKING changes when the input is rescaled, so running it on unrescaled data is a genuine scale-preserving entry into the 'scale' arm.

free.label: scale-free
free.note: Every series z-scored identically (leak-free, via eval_utils.standardize_on_observed), and methods with a choice of statistic use the scale-free one.  This is the real causal-discovery comparison; the VAR bar is ~0.61, not 0.85.

scale.label: scale-exploiting (published protocol)
scale.note: Unrescaled series, edges scored by raw |coefficient|.  This is the cell that produces the published VAR 0.85, and it is substantially a var-sortability prior: discharge volume grows downstream, so magnitude encodes direction.
